items.titleEn: Fleetwood Town v Arsenal: Carabao Cup fourth round – live
items.summaryEn: ⚽ League Cup updates from the 8pm GMT kick-off⚽ Game briefly delayed by drone over Highbury | Mail NiallHere’s the Fleetwood head coach, Matt Lawlor: “We’ve had to make changes, with the champions in town. But we’ve got a plan with substitutions to manage the game. Arsenal have paid us a lot of respect by naming such a strong team … it’s a very difficult challenge, but one we should enjoy, and not be overawed.”“I was just thinking, with the two Highburys – I can only think of the St James(’) Parks (Exeter and Newcastle), but are there any other grounds with very similar names?” asks Shaun T. Continue reading...
bodyEn: 38 mins: Lewis-Skelly finds Timber in the area and the ball ricochets to Dowman, whose cross has to be cleared away from danger.

37 mins: Fleetwood centre-back Shaun Rooney (no relation) is a big aerial threat – while at St Johnstone, he scored the winner in two Cup finals in the same season. He’s pushing forward whenever the hosts have a chance to get upfield.
36 mins: A spell of lukewarm Arsenal pressure is ended as Fleetwood get a free kick, allowing keeper Lynch to heave the ball clear.
34 mins: After a spell of Arsenal possession, O’Neill cuts inside and thwacks it towards the danger area, but Harrison Neal is in place to block it away.
33 mins: Northern Ireland manager Michael O’Neill is here, casting an eye over Fleetwood’s Conor Haughey and namesake Ceadach of Arsenal.
32 mins: Dowman prods the ball past Haughey but can’t keep it from rolling out for a goal kick.
I guess Marli Salmon heard Arteta’s ‘Give me a headache, give me a problem’ request,” honks Andrew Schultz.
31 mins: O’Neill takes the Arsenal corner and swings it towards Havertz, but Bennett is able to head away from danger.
29 mins: Gyokeres has a go from 20 yards that’s on target, but easy for Cods keeper Jay Lynch to get down and gather.
27 mins: Arsenal are pushing forward but that inevitably leaves gaps in behind, and Evans is almost in the right place to latch on to a through ball.
24 mins: Arsenal can’t make anything happen with a scrappy bit of possession in the Fleetwood area, and then Hincapie hoofs a clearance into the car park. Safe to say Arteta’s side haven’t settled.

Marli Salmon won’t want to watch that back; he let Loupalo-Bi get beyond him and his attempted late tackle only pushed the ball further away, allowing the striker to drill it clinically past Meslier. Sweet Carabao!
Fourth-tier Fleetwood take the lead!! It’s Fulham loanee Aaron Loupalo-Bi with the opener, and Highbury goes wild!
18 mins: A first opening for Arsenal on the break as Dowman crosses to Gyokeres, who can’t prod the ball home under pressure. And then …

“Good to see Ceadach O’Neill starting. His two uncles (Paddy & Eoin Bradley) were top class GAA players for Derry,” writes John Brennan. “Eoin was also a top player in the Irish League, winning a few cups along with getting a six-game ban for urinating in Windsor Park during a televised cup semi-final.” Well, that took a turn.
15 mins: THUNK! After nice buildup work from Dowman, Lewis-Skelly goes for a 50-50 with Rooney but the Fleetwood defender prevails, and the thud of the challenge could probably be heard in Blackpool.
14 mins: Another Fleetwood long throw aimed towards veteran forward Ched Evans, and mopped up by Meslier at the far post.
12 mins: Fleetwood launch a long throw into the danger area, where it’s flicked on by Bennett – but Arsenal get it clear.

The drone has now disappeared, so the referee opts to restart. There are also murky reports of the culprit being apprehended by police. So, it’s back to the game, which will have at least eight minutes added to the first half.

“Who’s the wanker with the drone?” bellow the 5,000-strong home faithful, while the referee talks to Mikel Arteta, Matt Lawlor and various security staff. And now he’s waving the players back to the tunnel!

Arsenal get upfield early on and have a free kick … but play is suspended as the referee, Michael Salisbury, peers up at a distant light in the sky. There’s a drone hovering over Highbury, and it’ll need to be dealt with somehow.
On grounds with the same(ish) name, Tim Gutteridge writes: “I give you Liverpool (Anfield) and Stirling Albion who, until 1993, played their home games at Annfield (with an extra N).”

“The similarities don’t stop there. For much of their history, Stirling Albion played in an all-red strip. And between 1970 and 1973 they were managed by Bob Shankly, the older brother of Liverpool’s Bill.”
Arsenal kick off, in their navy away threads with red and yellow strip. Fleetwood’s home kit is an Arsenal-esque red number with white sleeves.

The players are out on the pitch, in a fug of firework smoke after some very rapid-fire pyro greeted their arrival. Peter Drury, never knowingly understated, is the Sky commentator and is already talking nights with the stars, marble halls and “two teams galaxies apart”. Let’s go!

“I like to root for the underdog, so fingers crossed the Fishermen of the Cod Army will catch a really big one today!” cheers Peter Oh. It may interest you, Peter, that Fleetwood have a sub called Andy Cannon – surely destined to come on and sink the Gunners.

“‘Arsenal have paid us a lot of respect by naming such a strong team’?Not sure why Matt Lawlor’s being so polite, Arteta’s taking the proverbial Michael with that side. Three kids and a goalie on debut?” writes Dave Estherby. To be fair, one of those kids is Max Dowman, and there are a few first-team regulars in there.

Here’s the Fleetwood head coach, Matt Lawlor: “We’ve had to make changes, with the champions in town. But we’ve got a plan with substitutions to manage the game. Arsenal have paid us a lot of respect by naming such a strong team … it’s a very difficult challenge, but one we should enjoy, and not be overawed.”
“I was just thinking, with the two Highburys – I can only think of the St James(’) Parks (Exeter and Newcastle), but are there any other grounds with very similar names?” asks Shaun T.

“It’s very special, coming to these kinds of grounds – it’s proper English football,” says Mikel Arteta. “In these kinds of conditions, you’re in or you’re out. It’s great to have Marli, Max and Ceadach with us, Ilhan Meslier as well who is making his first appearance for us.” His advice to those young Gunners? “Give me a headache, give me a problem – give me a reason to play you.”

There is one other fourth-round Carabao Cup tie tonight, and it’s an all-League One affair. Bradford City, finalists in 2013, host Robbie Savage’s Peterborough – guaranteeing that at least one third-tier side will make the quarter-finals. Like the match at Highbury, it will go to penalties if still level after 90 minutes – and there’s no VAR.

So, Ilhan Meslier makes his debut in goal for Arsenal, with Christian Mosquera and Piero Hincapie starting as they return from injury; Martin Zubimendi also gets a run-out, while youngsters Max Dowman, Marli Salmon and Ceadach O’Neill all included in Mikel Arteta’s starting XI.
Fleetwood Town (3-5-2): Lynch, Haughey, Potter, Bennett; Rooney, Neal, McLean, Helm, Batty; Evans, Loupalo-Bi. Subs: Pradic, Andrew, Cannon, Davies, Thomas, Murphy, Coughlan, Robertson, Cirino.

Arsenal (4-2-3-1): Meslier; Timber, Mosquera, Salmon, Hincapie; Zubimendi, Lewis-Skelly; Dowman, Havertz, O’Neill; Gyokeres. Subs: Arrizabalaga, White, Odegaard, Eze, Konsa, Guimaraes, Hashi, Washington, Harriman-Annous.
Referee: Michael Salisbury (Lancashire)

To give everyone a flavour of conditions, it is blowing a gale around the rather quaint Highbury Stadium, almost blowing my laptop onto the pitch. Mikel Arteta will not be too worried about his players adapting to the conditions and will see a front pairing of Kai Havertz and Viktor Gyökeres as integral to killing this game off as soon as possible.

Fleetwood, however, are here to give the Gunners a bloody nose at the very least. They know how to utilise the conditions to their favour and will be straight into the faces of the Premier League champions. They may sit 18th in League Two, but they saw off Sheffield United in the last round and will fancy doing likewise in front of a packed ground.
Some sad news to bring you: Peter Dobing, the captain of Stoke’s 1972 League Cup winning side, has died at the age of 87.

Dobing made 377 appearances over a decade with the Potters and also played for Blackburn and Manchester City. He captained Stoke to glory as they beat Chelsea 2-1 to clinch their first (and only) major trophy, before his playing career was ended by injury just one year later.

Stoke said in a statement: “All at Stoke are deeply saddened to learn of the passing of our ’72 League Cup-winning captain Peter Dobing at the age of 87. The thoughts and sincere condolences of all are with Peter’s friends and family at this immensely difficult time.”
Some essential pre-match reading here from Will Unwin, our man on the Fylde coast tonight.

Some Arsenal fans spent years pining for one more game at Highbury Stadium; tonight, they finally get their wish. This particular Highbury is 250 miles northwest of Islington – the home of Fleetwood Town, a team the Gunners have never played before.

While their League Two form could hardly be less remarkable (18th place, with 14 points from 13 games), Fleetwood have picked off Chesterfield, Shrewsbury and second-tier Sheffield United in the Carabao Cup without conceding a goal, earning a last-16 glamour tie against the English champions.

With a trip to Anfield looming on Sunday, Mikel Arteta is expected to give his weariest stars a rest. Young talents like Marli Salmon, Ceadach O’Neill and, yes, Max Dowman are expected to start. They can expect testing conditions at a seaside ground where “the wind goes in all directions”.
Of course, even a depleted and under-experienced Arsenal side will be hot favourites to advance, but this has all the makings of a classic midweek Cup test. Kick-off: 8pm GMT.

items.titleZh: 弗利特伍德镇对阵阿森纳：联赛杯第四轮直播
items.summaryZh: 阿森纳客场对阵弗利特伍德镇的联赛杯第四轮比赛实况更新。
bodyZh: 38分钟：刘易斯-斯凯利在禁区内找到廷贝尔，皮球折射给道曼，随后他的传中被险险解围。
37分钟：弗利特伍德中卫肖恩-鲁尼（非亲属）极具头球威胁——效力圣约翰斯通时，他曾在同一个赛季的两场杯赛决赛中打入制胜球。每当主队有机会推进时，他都会积极前插。
36分钟：阿森纳一段不温不火的攻势在弗利特伍德获得任意球后结束，门将林奇将球大脚解围。
34分钟：在阿森纳控球后，奥尼尔内切并大力抽射危险区域，但哈里森-尼尔及时到位将球封堵。
33分钟：北爱尔兰主帅迈克尔-奥尼尔来到现场，正密切关注弗利特伍德的康纳-霍吉以及同名同姓的阿森纳球员凯达赫-奥尼尔。
32分钟：道曼将球捅过霍吉，但未能阻止皮球滚出底线形成球门球。
安德鲁-舒尔茨调侃道：“我猜马利-萨尔蒙听到了阿尔特塔‘给我制造麻烦，给我出难题’的要求。”
31分钟：奥尼尔主罚阿森纳角球并将球传向哈弗茨，但本尼特成功头球解围。
29分钟：约克雷斯在20码处起脚射门命中门框范围内，但对于“鳕鱼军团”门将杰伊-林奇来说接住并不困难。
27分钟：阿森纳正全力压上，但这不可避免地在后场留下了空当，埃文斯差一点就能接住直塞球。
24分钟：阿森纳在弗利特伍德禁区内的一阵混战中未能制造威胁，随后因卡皮耶一脚将球解围到了停车场。可以说阿尔特塔的球队还没进入状态。
马利-萨尔蒙一定不想再回看那一幕了；他被卢帕洛-比突破，随后试图补防的铲断反而把球挡得更远，让这名前锋冷静地推射穿过了梅利耶的十指关。精彩的联赛杯！
第四级别的弗利特伍德取得领先！！富勒姆租借球员亚伦-卢帕洛-比攻入首开纪录的进球，海布里球场陷入狂热！
18分钟：阿森纳通过反击获得第一次绝佳机会，道曼传中给约克雷斯，但在对方防守压力下未能将球打进。随后……
约翰-布伦南写道：“很高兴看到凯达赫-奥尼尔首发。他的两个叔叔（帕迪和埃因-布拉德利）曾是德里郡的顶级GAA球员。埃因也是爱尔兰联赛的顶级球星，赢得过几个杯赛冠军，不过也曾在电视转播的杯赛半决赛中因在温莎公园小便而被禁赛六场。”好吧，这话题转折得有点快。
15分钟：砰！在道曼出色的串联之后，刘易斯-斯凯利与鲁尼展开五五开的拼抢，但弗利特伍德后卫胜出，这次对抗的闷响大概在布莱克浦都能听到。
14分钟：弗利特伍德又一次掷出大力界外球直接飞向危险区域，被本尼特蹭了一下，最终由梅利耶在远门柱化解。
12分钟：弗利特伍德将界外球掷入禁区，本尼特头球后蹭，不过阿森纳将危险化解。
无人机现已消失，裁判选择重新开球。另有未经证实的报道称肇事者已被警方控制。因此，比赛得以恢复，上半场将至少补时八分钟。
“玩无人机的那个混蛋是谁？”五千名主场球迷大声吼道，同时裁判正在与米克尔-阿尔特塔、马特-劳勒以及多名安保人员交谈。现在他正挥手示意球员们退回球员通道！
阿森纳开场迅速推进并获得任意球……但比赛因主裁判迈克尔-萨利斯伯里凝视着天空中远处的灯光而暂停。海布里球场上空盘旋着一架无人机，必须设法处理。
关于球场名字相似的话题，蒂姆-古特里奇写道：“我给你们举个例子，利物浦（安菲尔德，Anfield）和斯特林阿尔比恩，他们在1993年之前一直将主场设在安菲尔德（Annfield，多了一个N）。”
“相似之处还不止于此。在其历史的大部分时间里，斯特林阿尔比恩都身披全红战袍。在1970年至1973年期间，他们的主教练是鲍勃-香克利，也就是利物浦传奇比尔-香克利的哥哥。”
阿森纳开球，身穿带有红黄条纹的海军蓝客场球衣。弗利特伍德的主场球衣则是类似阿森纳风格的红身白袖球衣。
球员们走上球场，在几发迎接他们到来、节奏极快的烟花所产生的烟雾中亮相。彼得-德鲁里这位向来不会低调的天空体育评论员，已经开始谈论繁星之夜、大理石走廊以及“两个处于不同星系的球队”。我们开始吧！
彼得-哦欢呼道：“我喜欢支持弱队，所以祈祷鳕鱼军团的渔夫们今天能捕获一条大鱼吧！”彼得，你或许会有兴趣知道，弗利特伍德替补席上有一位名叫安迪-坎农的球员——注定要替补登场并击沉枪手。
戴夫-埃瑟比写道：“‘阿森纳派出了这么强大的阵容，对我们表现出了极大的尊重’？不知道为什么马特-劳勒要这么客气，阿尔特塔排出的这套阵容简直是在开玩笑。三个小孩和一个上演首秀的门将？”平心而论，那些小孩之一正是马克斯-道曼，而且里面还有几名一线队常规主力。
以下是弗利特伍德主教练马特-劳勒的言论：“面对冠军驾到，我们不得不做出人员调整。但我们有通过换人来掌控比赛的计划。阿森纳派出了如此强大的阵容，对我们给予了极大的尊重……这是一场非常艰巨的挑战，但我们应该享受其中，而不是被吓倒。”
肖恩-·T问：“我刚才在想，除了两个海布里球场——我只能想到圣詹姆斯公园（埃克赛特和纽卡斯尔），还有其他名字非常相似的球场吗？”
米克尔-阿尔特塔表示：“来到这样的球场非常特别，这是地道的英格兰足球。在这样的条件下，你要么晋级要么出局。很高兴马利、马克斯和凯达赫能和我们在一起，伊兰-梅利耶也将迎来他为我们的第一次亮相。”他对这些年轻枪手的忠告是：“给我制造麻烦，给我出难题——给我一个派你上场的理由。”
今晚还有另一场联赛杯第四轮比赛，是一场纯英甲对决。2013年的亚军布拉德利城主场迎战罗比-萨维奇执掌的彼得伯勒——这确保了至少有一支第三级别球队能够杀入四分之一决赛。与海布里球场的比赛一样，如果90分钟战平将直接进入点球大战，且没有VAR。
因此，伊兰-梅利耶迎来了他在阿森纳门将位置上的首秀，克里斯蒂安-莫斯克拉和皮罗-因卡皮耶伤愈复出首发登场；马丁-祖比门迪也获得出场机会，同时年轻小将马克斯-道曼、马利-萨尔蒙和凯达赫-奥尼尔全部进入了米克尔-阿尔特塔的首发十一人名单。
弗利特伍德镇（3-5-2）：林奇，霍吉，波特，本尼特；鲁尼，尼尔，麦克莱恩，赫尔姆，巴蒂；埃文斯，卢帕洛-比。替补：普拉迪奇，安德鲁，坎农，戴维斯，托马斯，墨菲，考夫兰，罗伯逊，西里诺。
阿森纳（4-2-3-1）：梅利耶；廷贝尔，莫斯克拉，萨尔蒙，因卡皮耶；祖比门迪，刘易斯-斯凯利；道曼，哈弗茨，奥尼尔；约克雷斯。替补：阿里萨巴拉加，怀特，厄德高，埃泽，孔萨，吉马良斯，哈希，华盛顿，哈里曼-安努斯。
主裁判：迈克尔-萨利斯伯里（兰开夏郡）
为了让大家感受一下现场的条件，古朴的海布里球场周围正刮着狂风，几乎把我的笔记本电脑吹到球场上。米克尔-阿尔特塔不会太担心他的球员们适应这些条件，并将由卡位Kai Havertz和维克托-约克雷斯组成的前锋线视为尽快杀死比赛的关键。
然而，弗利特伍德来到这里至少要给枪手沉重打击。他们知道如何利用天气条件为自己谋利，并将直接向这位英超冠军发起冲击。尽管他们在英乙联赛中排名第18位，但他们在上一轮淘汰了谢菲尔德联，并且在一座座无虚席的球场前渴望再次复制这一壮举。
带给大家一个悲伤的消息：斯托克城1972年联赛杯冠军队队长彼得-多宾去世，享年87岁。
多宾在效力陶工十年的时间里出场377次，还曾效力于布莱克浦和曼城。他率领斯托克城以2-1击败切尔西，赢得了他们历史上第一座（也是唯一一座）主要奖杯，随后他的球员生涯在仅仅一年后因伤终结。
斯托克城在一份声明中表示：“斯托克城的所有人对我们72年联赛杯冠军队长彼得-多宾以87岁高龄离世深感悲痛。在这个极为艰难的时刻，所有人都向彼得的朋友和家人致以诚挚的慰问。”
以下是我们今晚派驻在菲尔德海岸的记者威尔-昂温带来的必备赛前阅读材料。
一些阿森纳球迷多年来一直渴望能在海布里球场多看一场比赛；今晚，他们的愿望终于实现了。这座特定的海布里球场位于伊斯灵顿西北方向250英里处——它是弗利特伍德镇的主场，这支球队是枪手从未交手过的对手。
尽管他们在英乙联赛中的表现平平（13场比赛积14分排名第18位），但弗利特伍德在联赛杯中先后淘汰了切斯特菲尔德、什鲁斯伯里和英冠的谢菲尔德联且一球未失，从而赢得了一场与英格兰冠军的焦点十六强赛。
随着周日客场对阵利物浦的比赛临近，预计米克尔-阿尔特塔会给最为疲惫的主力球员放假。马利-萨尔蒙、凯达赫-奥尼尔以及马克斯-道曼等青年才俊预计将首发登场。他们将在一个“风向四面八方乱吹”的海滨球场迎接严峻考验。
当然，即便是一支残阵且缺乏经验的阿森纳也将是晋级的绝对热门，但这场比赛具备了一场经典的周中杯赛考验的所有要素。开球时间：格林威治标准时间晚上8点。

items.titleEn: U21s report: AFC Wimbledon 1-2 Arsenal
items.summaryEn: We reached the knockout stages of the EFL Trophy with a comeback win in south London
bodyEn: We reached the knockout stages of the EFL Trophy for the first time in the group stage format as we came from behind to beat League One AFC Wimbledon 2-1 at the Cherry Red Records Stadium on Tuesday night.
A goalless first half wasn't without action as fantastic goal-saving blocks from Freddie Simmonds for Wimbledon and Elijah Upson for us were required to keep the scores blank in the opening 45.

Wimbledon took the lead right at the start of the second half through Callum Maycock, but we struck back with 20 minutes to play through substitute Evan Mooney, before Emerson Nwaneri continued his recent heroics with an 87th-minute winner.
FIRST HALF

Wimbledon probed in the early stages of the contest, keeping the game in our half, and came close to an early lead when Aron Sasu broke free on the right and forced a strong save from Khari Ranson from a tight angle.

We responded to the wake-up call with a chance of our own at the other end with Theo Julienne threading an excellent pass through to Mylo Bernard. Bernard took the ball in stride but lifted his effort over the crossbar.

Our young Gunners continued to keep the pressure on in the opening 20 minutes, with both James Scanlon and Igor Tyjon having efforts blocked in the penalty area as we took control of proceedings in south London.

The best chance of the half fell to James Scanlon shortly after, with the midfielder seemingly one-on-one with Joe McDonnell after a defensive miscue from Wimbledon, but Simmonds made a charging recovery run to save the Dons.
It was soon our turn to appreciate a goal-saving challenge as Upson flung himself in front of a shot from Ed Leach that had been heading for the corner of the net, keeping our clean sheet in tact.

We were on top towards the end of an entertaining first half and almost took the lead with a flowing move, only for Julienne to put a close-range effort straight at McDonnell with the goal at his mercy.
SECOND HALF

The Dons made a quick start to the second half, threatening in the opening minute. Steven Sessegnon broke forward and cut in on his right foot, before bending a fiercely struck effort just over the crossbar.
But a minute later the hosts were more clinical, taking the lead through a well-placed strike from Maycock, who picked out the bottom corner from just inside the penalty area.

We stepped up our tempo and enjoyed a good spell of possession after going behind, and forced the first save of real quality from McDonnell when Emerson Nwaneri drove a powerful effort towards goal from the edge of the 18-yard box.

Wimbledon came back into the game midway through the half and should've doubled their lead when Simmonds picked out Harry Hedges in space in the penalty area, but the Dons' winger struck the crossbar from close range.
With the hosts high up the pitch chasing a second goal, we caught them out on the counter-attack and found our equaliser through Mooney, who latched onto Nwaneri's ball across goal from close range.

The final 20 minutes was played at a high intensity with both sides vying for a winner, but it was our young Gunners who came out on top as Nwaneri's deflected effort found the bottom corner in the 87th-minute to send us through to the last 32.
WHAT IT MEANS
Victory in south London means we sit second in Southern Group F, guaranteeing our place in the last 32 in the week commencing Monday, December 7.
If Barnet, who are already through were to lose heavily at home to Leyton Orient in the final match in the group, we would win the group on goal difference.
WHAT'S NEXT
With the EFL Trophy knockout stages not getting underway until December, the next game for many of our young Gunners will be in Czechia against Slavia Prague in the UEFA Youth League.
Our under-21s are back in action on Sunday, November 8 with a Premier League 2 clash against Aston Villa at Mangata Developments Stadium (2pm UK).

items.titleZh: U21比赛报告：AFC温布尔登 1-2 阿森纳
items.summaryZh: 我们在客场逆转取胜，晋级英格兰足球联赛锦标赛淘汰赛阶段。
bodyZh: 周二晚上，我们在切里雷德球场以2-1逆转战胜英甲球队AFC温布尔登，在小组赛赛制下首次晋级英格兰足球联赛锦标赛的淘汰赛阶段。
上半场双方互交白卷，但并不缺乏精彩场面，温布尔登的弗雷迪·西蒙兹和我们的埃利贾·厄普森分别做出精彩的门线救险，力保前45分钟球门不失。
温布尔登在下半场刚开始时由卡勒姆·梅科克取得领先，但我们在比赛还剩20分钟时由替补登场的埃文·穆尼扳平比分，随后埃默森·恩瓦内里在第87分钟打入制胜球，延续了他近期的神勇表现。
上半场
温布尔登在比赛初段频频试探，将战局控制在我们半场，并险些早早取得领先，当时阿龙·萨苏在右路摆脱防守，逼迫哈里·兰森在小角度做出一次神勇扑救。
我们随后做出回应，在对方禁区制造威胁，西奥·朱利安送出一记精妙直塞找到迈洛·伯纳德。伯纳德顺势接球，但射门稍稍高出横梁。
在比赛的前20分钟里，我们的青年枪手持续施压，詹姆斯·斯坎伦和伊戈尔·泰永的射门均在禁区内被封堵，我们逐渐掌控了在南伦敦的局势。
上半场最好的机会不久后落在了詹姆斯·斯坎伦脚下，温布尔登防线失误后，这位中场球员似乎获得了与乔·麦克唐纳单刀的机会，但西蒙兹高速回追完成了关键解围。
很快轮到我们展现精彩的门线救险，厄普森飞身挡出了埃德·利奇直奔球门死角的射门，力保我们的城门不失。
在精彩的上半场尾声阶段我们占据上风，并险些通过一次流畅的配合取得领先，但朱利安在门前绝佳机会下的近距离射门被麦克唐纳直接没收。
下半场
温布尔登在下半场开局阶段迅速进入状态，并在第一分钟制造威胁。史蒂文·塞塞尼翁带球向前内切并起右脚兜射，皮球稍稍高出横梁。
但仅仅一分钟后，主队展现了更高的效率，梅科克在禁区边缘迎球推射破门，打入死角，帮助主队取得领先。
丢球后我们提升了比赛节奏，并掌控了一段时间的球权，迫使麦克唐纳做出了一次高质量扑救，当时埃默森·恩瓦内里在18码禁区边缘轰出一脚极具威胁的重炮轰门。
温布尔登在下半场中段重新掌握主动，本有机会扩大领先优势，当时西蒙兹在禁区内找到无人防守的哈里·赫奇斯，但这位温布尔登边锋近距离射门击中横梁。
随着主队全线压上寻找第二球，我们抓住反击机会扳平比分，穆尼接应恩瓦内里横传门前包抄破门。
最后的20分钟比赛节奏极快，双方都在争夺制胜球，但最终还是我们的青年枪手笑到了最后，恩瓦内里在第87分钟的射门发生折射钻入球门死角，将我们送入32强。
这意味着什么
客场取胜意味着我们在南方F组排名第二，确保了我们晋级12月7日那一周进行的最后32强。
如果已经晋级的巴尼特在小组最后一场比赛中主场惨败给莱顿东方，我们将凭借净胜球优势获得小组头名。
接下来
由于英格兰足球联赛锦标赛淘汰赛直到12月才开始，我们的许多青年枪手下一场比赛将前往捷克参加对阵布拉格斯拉维亚的欧洲青年联赛。
我们的U21梯队将于11月8日星期日重返赛场，在曼加塔发展球场进行一场英超2级联赛对阵阿斯顿维拉的比赛（英国时间下午2点）。

items.summaryEn: Find out who will be starting in our trip to Fleetwood in the Carabao Cup Fourth Round at Highbury Stadium
bodyEn: Mikel Arteta has made nine changes for our trip to Fleetwood Town in the Carabao Cup fourth round, with Illan Meslier and Ceadach O'Neill making their debuts.
Meslier, who joined us in the summer, starts in goal at Highbury Stadium, with Northern Ireland international O'Neill, 18, making his first senior appearance.
Jurrien Timber starts at right-back, with teenager Marli Salmon, Cristhian Mosquera and Piero Hincapie completing the backline.
Martin Zubimendi, who made a substitute appearance against Everton, starts in midfield alongside Myles Lewis-Skelly.
Ceadach is on the opposite wing to fellow teenager Max Dowman, who was player of the round last month after a sparkling display against Ipswich Town.
Kai Havertz and Viktor Gyokeres complete the line-up as we bid to reach the last eight for the third year in a row.

items.titleEn: Renée and Alessia on “tough side” Benfica
items.summaryEn: Renée Slegers and Alessia Russo are expecting a tough test in Wednesday’s visit of Benfica in the UEFA Women’s Champions League.
bodyEn: Renée Slegers and Alessia Russo are expecting a tough test in Wednesday’s visit of Benfica in the UEFA Women’s Champions League.
The Portuguese champions have won four games from four in the league this season, but in Europe are looking to respond to a 3-0 loss to Bayern Munich.

Asked how we’ll approach Benfica tactically this week, our head coach said in Tuesday’s pre-match press conference: “They have their identity, of course. Remember the game from last year that we played there away, they made it hard for us, we ended up winning 2-0.

“They've played their two games against Juventus and Bayern. They compete and we know that they will compete against us tomorrow as well. So there will be some similarities. They have their identity, a really robust, compact structure in the league. They've had an amazing run since 2024, I think.
“So there's a lot of similarities based on the last game we played against them but they do something slightly different. Some personnel is different as well.”

Asked if we can take anything from last season’s trip to Benfica, when we won 2-0 thanks to goals from Beth Mead and Russo, the latter continued: “Yes, I mean like Renée said, we know they're a really tough side to break down. We saw that when we played them away. We saw that when they played Bayern, they didn't score until late on in the game and I think it doesn't matter when we score.

“Of course, we'd love to score in the first couple of minutes but sometimes football doesn't work like that. So we're prepared, we'll do everything we can to break them down as early as possible but we know they have threats and we have to be aware of that too. So yes, we're confident going into the game but whether it comes in the first minute or the last minute, we're focused on the win no matter how.”
Renée was also asked if it’s good to have this game coming up so quickly after our north London derby success, and if we can use that to keep the positive momentum going.

“Absolutely, I think we love it and the players love it,” she said. “Playing so many games, that's why here at Arsenal we want to compete, play our games. That's the best, we look forward to Meadow Park, the closest to the fans. Champions League is always special. Special nights for the fans.

“How they were during the game and after the game was incredible. They're the best, so that moment afterwards we knew how important it was for us but also for the fans to get the win against Tottenham. I was really happy we could reward them for their resilience as well, so we look forward to the game tomorrow.”

items.titleZh: 雷妮与阿莱西亚谈“顽强对手”本菲卡
items.summaryZh: 雷妮·斯勒格斯与阿莱西亚·鲁索展望欧冠对阵本菲卡的硬仗。
bodyZh: 雷妮·斯勒格斯与阿莱西亚·鲁索预计，阿森纳在周三进行的欧洲女子冠军联赛中主场迎战本菲卡将会是一场严峻的考验。
这支葡萄牙联赛冠军本赛季在联赛中取得了四战全胜的战绩，但在欧战中，他们正力图从上一场0比3负于拜仁慕尼黑的比赛中反弹。
在周二的赛前新闻发布会上，当被问及本周我们将如何从战术上应对本菲卡时，我们的主教练表示：“他们当然有自己的风格。还记得去年我们在客场对阵他们的比赛吗，他们给我们制造了很大的麻烦，最终我们以2比0取胜。”
“他们已经对阵尤文图斯和拜仁踢了两场比赛。他们具备竞争力，我们也知道他们明天也会对我们发起挑战。因此会有一些相似之处。他们在联赛中拥有自己的风格、非常稳固且紧凑的阵型。我认为自2024年以来，他们打出了一段惊艳的连胜。”
“所以根据我们上一次对阵他们的比赛来看，有很多相似之处，但他们做了一些略微不同的调整。部分人员也有所变动。”
当被问及我们是否能从上赛季客场对阵本菲卡的比赛中借鉴经验时——当时我们凭借贝丝·米德和鲁索的进球以2比0取胜，鲁索接着说道：“是的，就像雷妮说的，我们知道他们是一支非常难以攻破的强队。我们在客场对阵他们时看到了这一点，我们也看到他们在对阵拜仁时，直到比赛尾声才丢球，而且我认为什么时候进球并不重要。”
“当然，我们很希望能在一开场前几分钟就进球，但有时候足球并不按常理发展。所以我们做好了准备，我们会竭尽全力尽早攻破他们的防线，但我们也知道他们很有威胁，我们也必须对此保持警惕。所以是的，我们对这场比赛充满信心，但无论是第一分钟还是最后一分钟进球，我们无论如何都专注于取得胜利。”
雷妮还被问到，在北伦敦德比取胜后这么快迎来这场比赛是否是件好事，以及我们是否可以借此保持积极的势头。
她说：“当然，我认为我们很喜欢这样，球员们也很喜欢。踢这么多比赛，这就是为什么我们阿森纳想要竞争、踢好我们的比赛。这感觉太棒了，我们期待着回到美多公园球场，最贴近球迷的地方。欧冠总是很特别的。对球迷来说是特别的夜晚。”
“他们在比赛中和比赛后的表现令人难以置信。他们是最好的，所以在赛后那个时刻，我们知道这场对阵托特纳姆热刺的胜利对我们以及球迷来说是多么重要。我非常高兴我们能用胜利回报他们的坚韧，所以我们期待着明天的比赛。”

items.titleEn: Every word of Renée’s and Alessia’s pre-Benfica presser
items.summaryEn: Slegers and Russo sat down at the Sobha Realty Training Centre on Tuesday for their pre-Benfica press conference
bodyEn: Renée Slegers and Alessia Russo sat down in front of the media at the Sobha Realty Training Centre on Tuesday for their pre-Benfica press conference.
The pair looked ahead to Wednesday's UEFA Women's Champions League clash at Meadow Park in Borehamwood.
Here's everything they had to say on the following subjects...

on the last couple of days since the north London derby:RS: It's been good. Players and staff had the day off the day after. And I think you could see in the celebrations after the game how good that was for us and the energy it created. We've come back in, so it's been the balance of recovering post-game and then getting ready for the Benfica game tomorrow, of course. And there's been great energy.

on enjoying the penalty and celebrations:AR: Yeah, it was really nice. I think you could see in how we played in the game, but also how we celebrated at the end that it meant a lot to win the north London derby. It means a lot to the club, to us players and staff. So, yeah, it felt really nice to get that win and we hope now that it can build momentum going into these next few games.
on Reid’s and Agyemang’s injuries:RS: They're not back yet, and it's the same as for the last game. Frida's progressing well too, but tomorrow will come too soon. Kim Little is back in the squad.
on if Katie is struggling:RS: We'll see. She's, of course, coming back from a long-term injury. So hopefully everything's okay and we'll do some assessment.

on if Catley and Hinds playing together is a long-term solution:RS: I think they did incredibly well in the game. I think it played out the way we wanted it to, and credit to the players on the pitch for getting it so right and doing their role with so much conviction and quality. So I think the left side in particular had a really good game, but us as a collective, I think the way we play with intensity, with fight in the game, with the grittiness that is necessary in a north London derby, that's for us the foundation. In the performances going forward as well. There were some really good things, but now we have to back it up and the next one's tomorrow.

on if our overall mood has changed with the clocks changing, and if we’re block by block rather than game by game:RS: Game by game still. I think my kids haven't gotten used to the change of clocks yet! It was raining, by the way, this morning. It was lovely and sunny when we were out on the training pitch. No, we stick with game by game. It's important for us. We don't look too far ahead. We're very excited for the Champions League game tomorrow. Excited to be back close with the fans at Meadow Park and play under the lights. I know what it means for the players to play in the Champions League, so game by game, and the next one is Benfica.

on if playing against Spurs is good practice for Benfica:RS: There are some similarities we expect. I think the amount of duelling in the north London derby, the physicality on the pitch, the intensity that was necessary in the battle on the pitch, we expect the same tomorrow. They're a very robust team with a good organisation, good structures, and they fight. So, in that sense, we expect to face something similar. The good thing is that we did that well in the game on the weekend, and we want to go to the next level with it.

on the Ballon d’Or:AR: Yeah, it was really nice. I think it's special to celebrate people's seasons and bring the football world together. It was nice to go with Mariona. Yeah, I think it's a moment where you can enjoy the highs and lows of football. I think it was a special night to see, obviously, Harry Kane win. I was so excited about that. I think he's one of my role models growing up, and I think as soon as he got announced, I had goosebumps. Obviously, Alexia [Putellas] is an incredible player as well, so I think it was really nice to celebrate their individual moments. Then I also think it gives you some motivation to want to kick on. I know what we want to achieve as a team this year, and maybe it's been tough to begin with, but I believe that we've still got great things ahead in this team and this season.

on if she pushes through blips in form like Kane:AR: I mean, it's an honour to say that I'm anything like Harry Kane, but I think that I definitely try and learn off him. I think he's an incredible leader and player. I love how he drops a bit deeper, he gets on the ends of crosses, he finds half a yard to shoot, he's good off both feet. So, yeah, I think if there's anyone's game that I could try and learn from, it would be his.

on if we’ve had to be grittier in our mentality this season:AR: 100 per cent. I think you always learn different things throughout seasons. You pose different challenges, and I think, yeah, you have to dig deep. I think, for sure, times have been a little bit tougher, but we've got a resilient squad, resilient people around us, and I think sometimes tough moments bring out really great things from teams, and I hope that's what we're going to go on to do this season as well.

on what we want to see more of after the win against Spurs:RS: Yeah, so like I just said, the foundation for us in the win was the intensity that we brought to the game, us as a collective attacking and defending together, the fight, the grittiness, the resilience, because also they scored the first goal in the game and we have to come back from it. So those things are important for us, and we definitely want to bring that to tomorrow night's game as well. I think the goal that we scored, Alessia sets up the opportunity for Georgia, how we make several deep runs, I think it's the third or the fourth run that we break the line with, and then we have so much composure to set up a player forward facing and to get a finish off. That was really positive and something we've been working on talking about. So if we can do that more often and bring that even more to games consistently, we know the quality in the squad. But yeah, the foundation was definitely in the grittiness and the fight.

on if there’s more of an emphasis now on success in the Champions League:RS: Even though the start has been tough for us and there's been results that we aren't happy with, I still think it's too early to say because there's so much to play for still in the league as well. So like I just said, it's game by game and we're very proud to be part of the Champions League again. It's a fantastic stage and that's what we're focused on so Benfica tomorrow.

on how we approach coming up against Benfica tactically:RS: They have their identity, of course. Remember the game from last year that we played there away,t hey made it hard for us, we ended up winning 2-0. They've played their two games against Juventus and Bayern. They compete and we know that they will compete against us tomorrow as well. So there will be some similarities. They have their identity, a really robust, compact structure in the league. They've had an amazing run since 2024, I think. So there's a lot of similarities based on the last game we played against them but they do something slightly different. Some personnel is different as well.

on how to reset after missing a big opportunity as a striker:AR: First and foremost, I think it's about training. We train a lot on finishing moments, penalties as well. So I think whenever the moment comes, you know that you've done the work in the week and that's something that gives me confidence. Also, I think that's just how football goes. I think as a striker, as a forward, you know you're going to get chances and it's about doing as well as you can. I felt like it was a good contact, it was a good save [from Lize Kop early in the second half]. I didn't feel too much pressure going into the penalty. Obviously, I knew I wanted to score for the club for what it meant in that moment but you train for these moments all the time, so it trains you to be ready for them in the moments.

on if we can take anything from last season’s 2-0 win away to Benfica:AR: Yes, I mean like Renée said, we know they're a really tough side to break down. We saw that when we played them away. We saw that when they played Bayern, they didn't score until late on in the game and I think it doesn't matter when we score. Of course, we'd love to score in the first couple of minutes but sometimes football doesn't work like that. So we're prepared, we'll do everything we can to break them down as early as possible but we know they have threats and we have to be aware of that too. So yes, we're confident going into the game but whether it comes in the first minute or the last minute, we're focused on the win no matter how.

on what she does as a leader in difficult moments:AR: We have a squad full of young talent but also really experienced professionals that have been at the top of the game for a long time and I feel like I'm slowly edging towards that, so there is a responsibility on me to step up a little bit more. I think the way I lead is by how I train and what I give on the pitch. That's something that I commit to every day. But also, I'm quite a positive, laid-back person, so I think sometimes that can help the younger players when there is a lot of pressure on results and there are hard times. Maybe I think I can try and relieve some of their stress, which is something that I would pride myself on. I'm still learning as a leader. I have great people to look up to. I think that I try and help them as much as I can by being myself and authentic to me and hopefully I can continue to grow in that role as well.

on Cooney-Cross’ form this season:AR: The Kyra that I signed with four years ago to now is a completely different person and player. I think she's grown in so many different ways. She's matured. She's gone through some real, real hardships and I think that the way that she's come back into the team this season, not only mentally but also physically, I think being away and back at home for over six months to come back in and be pretty much ready to go is a testament to her. The work that she wanted to put in and the work that she wants to do for her mum. As a friend, first and foremost, I'm really proud of her the way she's stepped up this season and I think she's got a massive career ahead of her.

on how to deal with players like Hinds when they’re not playing:RS: What we do to help players is we have a really strong set-up in our technical team so we work with all players have their personal development plans and all coaches have a group of four or five players that they work with both from a review perspective training, isolated repetition technical repetition check-ins in general so I think all players and Taylor specifically has had really good support challenge and support which is always important for us for our PDP coach going both directions me and Taylor have had quite some conversations throughout both in the difficult times but also like I said to her after the game the performance that she puts on the way she plays the way she communicates the way she does her actions with conviction for 90 minutes and it's been a while since she played 90 minutes that was going to be in the Champions League so much respect for that and that's her and together with other staff at the club with the performance team medical team making sure that she's ready to go at this moment in the north London derby you see with how much heart she played in that game she cares for Arsenal and this game was important to her and I think you could see it in the way she behaved on the pitch and she did amazing so I'm just really happy for her she played a big role for the team in that game and this definitely put her in a good position going forward as well excellent.

on the understanding between Russo and Stanway:AR: Georgia was my first friend on England camp when we were about 13, so I think we've played together for a really long time. I understand what she's trying to do on the pitch and she understands me too, so I think there's a natural connection there. Again, someone I've played with for a really long time, so I think that's great and nice that it came off in the north London derby but yeah we work on a lot of things, especially when I'm a little bit deeper in that role and we're more closely connected, so yeah, she finds me in spaces that I know she'll give me the ball and vice versa so it was really nice to get that combination and she's a player that I love playing with.

on transitioning between the number 10 and number nine roles:AR: I feel like I've done it a lot more now, so it becomes a lot easier than it did at the start. I understand the role in and out of possession and I have good conversations with Renée and Aaron, who does the out-of-possession stuff too, so the role's really clear. I think a lot of the work that I do in the 9 is often a little bit deeper, so it has a lot of similarities with the number 10 position. I think ultimately I want to be scoring and creating as much as I can and I think you can do that both in the 9 and the 10 and we have great players that can play all over the front four, so I think it's just about how we can connect, how we can set up best opportunities for each other and play ourselves and each other into their strengths.

on helping Hinds to be prepared for minutes:AR: Something that I would say to a lot of the girls is that you always have to be ready. Football changes so fast and you're always going to be needed. We've seen that last year with players when they step up and they do great, so I think for Taylor it was about making sure that I'm there for her, if there's anything that she needed but making sure that I kept her ready and kept her mindset focused on when she gets an opportunity, she will take it and she did that. She stepped up and she knows we have so much quality in our squad and Taylor included. She got a chance and she did really great and I think that's credit to us and the team to have players that are so ready to step in and commit to the team and commit to what we're trying to build. So yeah, it was really nice to see.

on if she’s tempted to keep consistency in the line-up to build momentum:RS: That's always an important factor in how I think we start the game and finish the game. So again, for this one, we're looking at which 11 players we think are best for us to start but then we also know, with the Benfica opponent, that the way their games have played out, finishing is really important as well, so you have sharpness and quality and injections to finish the game. Trying to find the right balance there but yeah, of course consistency is an important one: freshness, readiness, short turnarounds, so that all plays in plus a million of other factors. We think we're in a good place for how we want to start and finish for tomorrow.

on if it’s good to have this game so soon after the derby win:RS: Absolutely, I think we love it and the players love it. Playing so many games, that's why here at Arsenal we want to compete, play our games. That's the best, we look forward to Meadow Park, the closest to the fans. Champions League is always special. Special nights for the fans. How they were during the game and after the game was incredible. They're the best, so that moment afterwards we knew how important it was for us but also for the fans to get the win against Tottenham. I was really happy we could reward them for their resilience as well, so we look forward to the game tomorrow.

on having a difficult run of form before the win against Spurs:AR: Of course, it's frustrating. We're all elite athletes, around elite sport and we want to win every single game but football doesn't always work like that. We've kind of just kept it simple, stripped things back and focused on the basics in training. Sometimes when things don't go your way, you can begin to overcomplicate and overanalyse and look too deeply into things. I think that's the last thing we've done. We've tried to just stay calm, stay free and focus on what we're good at and I think that's what we saw in the north London derby, we saw everyone playing with grit, playing with passion and hopefully we'll continue that going into Benfica tomorrow.

on if we feel different this week off the back of that win:AR: It was nice to win, especially the north London derby. I think we know what that means to this club and the history of this team, it's a game every season that we look forward to and we want to give to the fans. I don't think it matters who we play. We now know that that's the standard, that's the level of grit and togetherness that we show on the pitch and that's the standard. Renée's message for the game is that now we need to go and back it up and that's on us as players tomorrow, going out there against Benfica.

items.titleZh: 雷妮与阿莱西亚赛前新闻发布会发言全记录
items.summaryZh: 斯勒格斯与鲁索出席赛前发布会，展望对阵本菲卡比赛。
bodyZh: 雷妮·斯勒格斯和阿莱西亚·鲁索于周二在索布哈地产训练基地出席了对阵本菲卡比赛前的媒体新闻发布会。
两人展望了周三在博勒姆伍德梅多公园球场进行的欧洲女足冠军联赛较量。
以下是她们就以下话题所说的一切……
关于北伦敦德比之后的这两天：RS：感觉很好。球员和工作人员在赛后第二天放假一天。我想你可以从赛后的庆祝活动中看出这对我们有多好，以及它所产生的能量。我们已经回来了，所以这是一种平衡，既要在赛后恢复，又要为明天的本菲卡比赛做准备。而且能量很棒。
关于享受点球和庆祝活动：AR：是的，真的很好。我认为你可以从我们的比赛方式以及最后庆祝的方式中看出，赢得北伦敦德比对我们意义重大。这对俱乐部、我们球员和工作人员都意义重大。所以，能够取得这场胜利感觉真的很棒，我们希望现在这能为接下来的几场比赛建立势头。
关于里德和阿吉曼的伤情：RS：她们还没有回归，情况和上一场比赛一样。弗里达的恢复进展也很顺利，但明天复出还为时过早。金·利特尔已重返大名单。
关于凯蒂是否遇到困难：RS：我们拭目以待。她当然是从长期伤病中恢复过来。所以希望一切都好，我们会做一些评估。

关于卡特利和海因斯搭档是否是长期解决方案：RS：我认为她们在比赛中表现得极其出色。我认为比赛的进程正如我们所愿，功劳归于球场上的球员，她们做得非常对，以如此坚定的信念和高质量完成了各自的角色。所以我认为左路尤其有一场非常精彩的比赛，但作为整体，我认为我们以强度、战斗精神以及北伦敦德比所需的坚韧进行比赛的方式，这就是我们的基础。这也是未来表现的基础。有一些非常好的事情，但现在我们必须用表现来支持它，下一场比赛就是明天。

关于随着时钟拨回我们的整体情绪是否发生了变化，以及我们是否是逐场进行而不是逐场看来着：RS：依然是逐场进行。我想我的孩子还没习惯时间的变化！顺便说一句，今天早上在下雨。当我们在训练场上时，天气很好而且阳光灿烂。不，我们坚持一场一场来。这对我们很重要。我们不会看太远。我们对明天的欧冠比赛感到非常兴奋。很高兴能回到梅多公园球场与球迷拉近距离，并在灯光下踢球。我知道踢欧冠对球员意味着什么，所以要一场一场来，下一场是对阵本菲卡。
关于对阵热刺是否是对阵本菲卡的良好演练：RS：我们预计会有一些相似之处。我认为北伦敦德比中的拼抢次数、球场上的身体对抗、球场上战斗所需的强度，我们预计明天也会如此。他们是一支非常强悍的球队，有着良好的组织、良好的结构和拼搏精神。从这个意义上说，我们预计会遇到类似的情况。好消息是我们周末的比赛做得很好，我们想把它提升到下一个水平。

关于金球奖：AR：是的，真的很好。我认为庆祝人们的赛季并将足球世界聚集在一起是很特别的。和马里奥娜一起去很好。是的，我认为这是一个你可以享受足球高潮和低谷的时刻。我认为看到哈里·凯恩获胜是一个特别的夜晚。我对此感到非常兴奋。我认为他是我的榜样之一，我想一旦宣布，我就起鸡皮疙瘩了。显然，阿莱克西亚·普特利亚斯也是一名出色的球员，所以我认为庆祝他们个人的时刻真的很好。然后我也认为这给了你一些继续前进的动力。我知道我们今年作为一支球队想要取得什么成就，也许一开始很艰难，但我相信这支球队和这个赛季未来依然有伟大的事情等待着我们。
关于她是否像凯恩一样突破状态的低谷：AR：我的意思是，说我像哈里·凯恩是一种荣幸，但我认为我绝对会向他学习。我认为他是一位杰出的领袖和球员。我喜欢他如何稍微回撤得更深一点，他接到传中，找到半码射门的空间，他双脚都很出色。所以，是的，如果有什么人的比赛我可以尝试学习的话，那就是他的。
关于我们本赛季是否需要在心态上更加坚韧：AR：百分之百。我认为你在整个赛季中总会学到不同的东西。你面临着不同的挑战，我想，是的，你必须深入挖掘。我认为，当然，这段时间有点艰难，但我们有一支坚韧的球队，周围有坚韧的人，我认为有时艰难的时刻会激发出球队非常棒的东西，我希望这也是我们本赛季将要继续做的事情。

关于战胜热刺后我们想看到更多什么：RS：是的，就像我刚才说的，我们取胜的基础是我们带给比赛的强度，我们作为一个整体共同进攻和防守、战斗、坚韧、恢复力，因为他们也打进了比赛的第一球，我们必须从中恢复过来。所以这些对我们很重要，我们绝对希望把这些带到明天晚上的比赛中。我认为我们进球的那次进攻，阿莱西亚为乔治亚创造了机会，我们如何进行多次深度的跑动，我认为这是我们第三次或第四次通过跑动打破防线，然后我们非常镇定地将球传给面向前方的球员并完成射门。这非常积极，也是我们一直在努力讨论的事情。所以如果我们能更频繁地做到这一点并更一致地将这一点带入比赛，我们就知道阵容中的实力。但是的，基础绝对在于坚韧和战斗。
关于现在是否更强调欧冠的成功：RS：尽管开局对我们来说很艰难，而且有些结果我们并不满意，但我仍然认为现在下结论还为时过早，因为联赛中还有很多比赛要打。所以就像我刚才说的，我们要一场一场来，我们为再次成为欧冠的一员感到非常自豪。这是一个 fantastisch 的舞台，这就是我们所关注的，所以明天对阵本菲卡。

关于我们在战术上如何应对本菲卡：RS：当然，他们有自己的特点。还记得我们去年去那里打的客场比赛吗，他们给我们制造了困难，我们最终2-0赢了。他们已经对阵过尤文图斯和拜仁。他们有竞争力，我们知道他们明天也会和我们竞争。所以会有一些相似之处。他们有自己的特点，在联赛中有着非常强悍、紧凑的结构。我想自2024年以来他们有过惊人的连胜。因此，根据我们与他们进行的上一场比赛，有很多相似之处，但他们做的事情略有不同。一些人员也不同。

关于前锋错失良机后如何重置：AR：首先也是最重要的是，关于训练。我们在训练中经常练习射门时刻以及点球。所以我想每当那一周的时刻到来时，你知道你已经在这一周做好了工作，这给了我信心。此外，我认为这就是足球的运作方式。作为一名中锋、一名攻击手，你知道你会得到机会，关键是尽你所能做到最好。我觉得那是一次不错的接触，是一次不错的扑救（利兹·科普在下半场初期的扑救）。我在罚点球时没有感到太大压力。显然，我知道我想为俱乐部进球，因为这在当时意味着什么，但你一直在为这些时刻进行训练，所以它训练你在这些时刻做好准备。

关于我们能否从上赛季客场2-0战胜本菲卡的比赛中吸取任何经验：AR：是的，就像雷妮说的，我们知道他们是一支非常难缠的球队。当我们客场对阵他们时，我们看到了这一点。当他们对阵拜仁时，我们看到了这一点，直到比赛快结束时他们才进球，而且我认为我们什么时候进球并不重要。当然，我们希望在前几分钟进球，但有时足球并不是这样的。所以我们做好了准备，我们会尽一切可能尽早打破他们的防线，但我们也知道他们有威胁，我们也必须意识到这一点。所以是的，带着信心进入比赛，无论它是在第一分钟还是最后一分钟，无论如何我们都专注于胜利。

关于作为队长在困难时刻做什么：AR：我们有一支充满年轻天才的阵容，同时也有在顶级赛事中效力很长时间的非常有经验的职业球员，我觉得我正在慢慢向那个方向靠拢，所以我有责任多站出来一点。我认为我的领导方式是通过我的训练以及我在球场上的付出。这是我每天都承诺的事情。但同时，我是一个非常积极、随和的人，所以我想有时当对结果有很大压力且处于困难时期时，这可以帮助年轻球员。也许我认为我可以尝试减轻他们的一些压力，这是我引以为豪的事情。作为一名队长，我仍在学习。我有很棒的人可以仰望。我认为我通过做自己并保持真实来尽我所能地帮助他们，希望我能在这个角色中继续成长。

关于科尼-克罗斯本赛季的状态：AR：我四年前签约认识的基拉与现在完全是不同的人和球员。我认为她在很多不同的方面都有所成长。她成熟了。她经历了一些真正非常非常艰难的时期，我认为她本赛季重返球队的方式，不仅在精神上而且在身体上，离开并回到家乡六个月多，然后回来几乎随时准备上场，这对她来说是一个证明。她想要投入的工作以及她想为她妈妈做的工作。首先作为朋友，我为她本赛季的出色表现感到非常自豪，我认为她前途无量。

关于如何处理像海因斯这样没有上场时间的球员：RS：我们为了帮助球员所做的是，我们在技术团队中拥有一个非常强大的架构，因此我们与所有球员合作，制定她们的个人发展计划，所有教练都有一组四到五名球员，他们与她们合作，包括从复盘角度、训练、孤立重复训练、技术重复训练、一般签到，所以我认为所有球员，特别是泰勒，都得到了非常好的挑战和支持，这对我们的PDP教练双向沟通来说总是很重要的，我和泰勒在困难时期进行了很多对话，但就像我在赛后对她说的那样，她展现出的表现、她踢球的方式、她沟通的方式、她以90分钟的坚定信念完成动作的方式，而且她已经有一段时间没有踢满90分钟了，那将是在欧冠中，所以非常尊重这一点，这就是她，与俱乐部其他绩效团队、医疗团队的员工一起，确保她在这个时刻的北伦敦德比中准备好上场，你看到她在那场比赛中踢球是多么用心，她在乎阿森纳，这场比赛对她很重要，我想你可以从她在球场上的表现中看出这一点，她做得太棒了，所以我真的为她感到高兴，她在球队的那场比赛中发挥了重要作用，这绝对也为她接下来的发展奠定了良好的基础。

关于鲁索和斯坦威之间的默契：AR：当我们大约13岁时，乔治亚是我在英格兰训练营的第一个朋友，所以我想我们一起踢了很长时间的球。我明白她在球场上试图做什么，她也明白我，所以我想有一种自然的联系。同样，我和她一起踢球很长时间了，所以我想这很好，很高兴它在北伦敦德比中实现了，但是的，我们有很多事情要合作，特别是当我稍微回撤到那个角色并且我们联系更紧密时，所以是的，她会在我知道她会把球传给我的空间找到我，反之亦然，所以能够实现这种配合真的很好，她是我喜欢和她一起踢球的球员。

关于10号和9号角色之间的转换：AR：我觉得我现在做得更多了，所以比刚开始时容易多了。我理解有球和无球时的角色，我和雷妮以及负责无球战术的亚伦进行了很好的交流，所以这个角色非常明确。我认为我在9号位所做的很多工作通常稍微深入一些，所以它与10号位有很多相似之处。我认为最终我想尽可能多地进球和创造机会，我认为你在9号位和10号位都可以做到这一点，我们有出色的球员可以踢前场四人的任何位置，所以这只是关于我们如何联系，如何为彼此创造最佳机会，以及如何发挥我们和彼此的优势。

关于帮助海因斯为上场时间做好准备：AR：我对很多女孩说的一件事是，你必须随时准备好。足球变化太快了，你随时都会被需要。我们在去年看到球员们站出来表现出色，所以我想对泰勒来说，确保我在她身边，如果有任何她需要的，但要确保我让她保持准备好，让她的心态专注于当她有机会时，她会抓住它，她做到了。她站了出来，她知道我们阵容中有如此多的实力，包括泰勒在内。她得到了机会，她做得非常好，我认为这要归功于我们和团队，拥有能够随时站出来并致力于团队以及致力于我们正在努力建立的愿景的球员。所以是的，看到这一幕真的很好。

关于她是否倾向于保持阵容的一致性以建立势头：RS：这始终是我们认为如何开始比赛和结束比赛的重要因素。所以再次对于这场比赛，我们正在研究我们认为最适合我们首发的11名球员，但我们也知道，对于本菲卡这个对手，根据他们比赛的进行方式，收尾也非常重要，所以你要保持敏锐度、质量和活力来结束比赛。试图在其中找到正确的平衡，但是的，当然一致性是一个重要因素：新鲜感、准备就绪、短间歇，所有这些加上数百万的其他因素都在起作用。我们认为我们在明天的首发和收尾方式上处于一个很好的位置。

关于在德比取胜后不久进行这场比赛是否很好：RS：绝对是的，我想我们很喜欢，球员们也很喜欢。踢这么多比赛，这就是为什么我们在阿森纳想要竞争、踢我们的比赛。那是最好的，我们期待梅多公园，最接近球迷的地方。欧冠总是特别的。对球迷来说是特别的夜晚。他们在比赛中和比赛后的表现令人难以置信。他们是最好的，所以在随后的那一刻，我们知道这对我们以及对球迷来说击败托特纳姆热刺有多么重要。我真的很高兴我们也能回报他们的坚韧，所以我们期待明天的比赛。

关于在战胜热刺之前经历了一段艰难的状态：AR：当然，这令人沮丧。我们都是精英运动员，身处精英体育环境中，我们想赢得每一场比赛，但足球并不总是那样运作的。我们只是保持简单，剥离复杂的事情，专注于训练中的基础。有时当事情不如你所愿时，你可能会开始过度复杂化、过度分析并深入研究事情。我想这是我们最不应该做的事情。我们试图保持冷静，保持自由，专注于我们擅长的东西，我想这就是我们在北伦敦德比中看到的，我们看到每个人都带着坚韧、带着激情在踢球，希望我们将带着这种状态继续迎接明天对阵本菲卡的比赛。

关于在这场胜利之后我们本周的感觉是否有所不同：AR: 能够取胜感觉很好，尤其是北伦敦德比。我想我们知道这对这家俱乐部和这支球队的历史意味着什么，这是我们每个赛季都期待的比赛，我们想把它献给球迷。我认为我们和谁比赛并不重要。我们现在知道这就是标准，这就是我们在球场上表现出的坚韧和团结水平，这就是标准。雷妮对这场比赛的信息是，现在我们需要去支持它，这取决于我们作为球员明天在对阵本菲卡的比赛中走上球场。

items.titleEn: Relive some epic AWFC comebacks
items.summaryEn: After our comeback win in the north London derby, relive some of our best wins from behind
bodyEn: We came from behind to earn a vital north London derby victory over Tottenham, so why not cast your mind back to some of our best comeback victories over the years.
Having fallen a goal behind in the 13th-minute, Georgia Stanway drew us level in the north London derby before Alessia Russo's penalty settled the game in the second half.
Our Gunners are no stranger to coming from behind to secure a result, with outstanding comebacks against Manchester City and Aston Villa among some of our best in recent years.
Press play on the video at the top of the article to watch some of our best comeback victories from years gone by.

items.titleZh: 重温阿森纳女足的精彩逆转好戏
items.summaryZh: 在北伦敦德比逆转取胜后，让我们一起重温那些经典的逆转胜利。
bodyZh: 我们在落后的情况下逆转战胜托特纳姆热刺，取得了这场至关重要的北伦敦德比胜利，因此不妨回想一下近年来我们的一些最佳逆转胜利。
在开场第13分钟落后一球后，Georgia Stanway在北伦敦德比中扳平比分，随后阿莱西亚·鲁索在下半场罚入点球锁定胜局。
我们的枪手对于逆转取胜并不陌生，近年来对阵曼城和阿斯顿维拉的出色逆转就是我们最好的比赛之一。
点击文章顶部的视频播放按钮，观看我们过去几年中一些最精彩的逆转胜利。

items.titleEn: Preview: Fleetwood Town v Arsenal
items.summaryEn: Our Carabao Cup journey continued at Highbury - get all the stats, TV coverage, team news and more
bodyEn: Our Carabao Cup campaign continues at Highbury Stadium as we take on Fleetwood Town on Tuesday, October 27, at 8pm (UK time).
While the home ground may sound familiar, it will be our first-ever trip to Fleetwood's home in the northwest.

The League Two outfit have beaten Chesterfield, Shrewsbury and Championship side Sheffield United to reach the last 16. Find out all you need to know about our clash against The Fishermen with our preview below!
MAKING HISTORY
Fleetwood Town went from the sixth tier of English football in 2009 to finishing fourth in League One in just eight seasons.
After spending nine years in League One, they were relegated to League Two in 2023, where they have been ever since.
Despite that meteoric rise in the 2010s, Fleetwood's history with the Carabao Cup hasn't pulled up any trees - until this season.

Two victories over fellow League Two sides Chesterfield and Shrewsbury Town set up a home clash with Championship outfit Sheffield United. A Rhys Norrington-Davies own goal gave The Cods the win and a spot in the round of 16 for the first time in their history.

They've yet to get going in League Two this season, winning only three matches and just one in their last eight games. But Matt Lawlor's men will be putting that to one side as they look to reach their first-ever quarter-final.
WHAT THE MANAGERS SAY

Arteta: “Our reputation, our pride, everything is in play. So every time you play a football match, and especially against a team in a different division, respect the game, respect every opponent because they deserve that, and then try to win and try to play a bit better than them.

"We know the risk, and in football, things can get very equal the moment you are able to match certain things, and that's why our basics and habits have to be through the roof to be able to win the game."

Lawlor: “The champions are coming to town and they’re coming to our patch. The players need to be excited by it, not overawed by it. The respect is through the roof, but the fear can’t be through the roof.
“We’ve earned a game like this. We’ve had to go through round upon round of tough games, and none of them were easy. To get to where we are, we deserve that.”
TEAM NEWS

Piero Hincapie and Cristhian Mosquera were both named on the bench for our home victory over Everton, with the former making a matchday squad once again after missing our draw with Bayern. Mosquera is yet to feature since coming off with an injury in a 1-0 win over Aston Villa but has been in the last three matchday squads.

Mikel Arteta ruled out Bukayo Saka before our match against the Toffees as he undergoes further assessment. He joins William Saliba and Christos Tzolis on the treatment table as the pair work hard to return to first-team action.
As for our hosts, midfielder Andy Cannon has returned to training and is available for selection, although manager Matt Lawlor said he will manage his minutes.
Defender Finley Potter is also available despite suffering a cut above his eye. Midfielder Kane Thompson-Sommers and defender Will Johnson are injured and will miss the match.
TALKING TACTICS

Adrian Clarke: “Under Matt Lawlor, Fleetwood Town like to play in a 3-1-4-2 formation, so it will be fascinating to see if they are brave enough to start with two centre forwards against us. If they do opt for a little more pragmatism, that shape could easily morph into a 5-4-1 without causing major disruption.

“Lawlor has another tactical quandary ahead of this cup tie, and that’s over how much he wants to urge his players to press us. In League Two they are the best ‘pressing outfit’, producing the most press sequences, and second highest number of high turnovers. If they play their natural game, it could help them earn opportunities to score, but if we play through them the rearguard may become very exposed.

“Fleetwood Town are a strong set piece side, netting six league goals already from those situations. In general, the Fylde Coast minnows are at their best when delivering crosses into the danger zone. They rank second in their division for quantity of open play crosses. With goalscorers Ronan Coughlan and Ched Evans attacking those balls, they do present a threat from those situations.
“In terms of individuals, keep your eye on buccaneering right wing back Lewis McCann. The Scot is an aggressive ball winner, who likes to power forward and whip crosses into the box.
“Fleetwood’s most creative player is midfielder Mark Helm. He’s laid on 23 chances, 22 from open play, which is 10 more than anyone else in the squad."
FACTS AND STATS
We have never played Fleetwood in any competition. The Cod Army are winless in all five of their matches against top-flight opponents in their history (D1 L4).
Fleetwood will be the 68th different team we've faced in the League Cup. We've lost only one of the last 18 clubs they have faced (W13 D4), a 1-0 defeat to Wigan in January 2006.

This is our 10th League Cup tie against a side from the fourth tier of English football. We've progressed from eight of our nine previous ties but were knocked out by Bradford City in 2012-/13 on penalties after a 1-1 draw in our most recent game.

For the first time in their history, Fleetwood Town have reached the League Cup fourth round. Before this season, they'd only progressed from six out of 20 ties and kept just one clean sheet in 20 games – but the Cod Army are yet to concede this season. The last fourth tier side to keep four clean sheets in a season was Tranmere Rovers in 1988/89.

Eberechi Eze has been involved in seven goals in his last four League Cup appearances against sides from outside the Premier League (two goals, five assists), scoring in our 2-0 win over Port Vale last season.

Max Dowman scored twice in the third round at Ipswich aged just 16 years and 258 days. He has made three appearances in the League Cup – the only player to play more before the age of 17 for Premier League clubs is Harvey Elliott, who made four appearances for Fulham (one) and Liverpool (three) before turning 17.
MATCH OFFICIALS

Michael Salisbury is the man with the whistle for our match against Fleetwood Town. He has refereed us twice before - a 4-0 win over Bournemouth in September 2023 and a 2-2 draw against Crystal Palace in April 2025.

There will be no VAR for our visit to Highbury Stadium. This is because of the EFL ruling that VAR can be used only in rounds of the competition when every stadium hosting a match has access to the technology.
If scores are level at 90 minutes, match goes straight to penalties. Should we progress, the draw will take place on Wednesday evening, live on Sky Sports Main Event.
Referee: Michael SalisburyAssistants: Matthew Wilkes and Alex JamesFourth official: Lewis Smith
LIVE COVERAGE
Sky Sports Main Event is your place to watch our trip to Fleetwood Town, which kicks off at 8pm UK time.
You can also find out which broadcasters are showing the action live, wherever you are in the world.

items.titleZh: 前瞻：弗利特伍德镇对阵阿森纳
items.summaryZh: 我们的英联杯征程在海布里继续，获取各项数据、转会及球队动态。
bodyZh: 阿森纳的英联杯征程将在海布里球场继续，我们将于10月27日星期二英国时间晚上8点对阵弗利特伍德镇。
虽然主场名字听起来很熟悉，但这将是我们历史上首次前往西北部弗利特伍德的主场。
这支英乙球队先后击败了切斯特菲尔德、什鲁斯伯里和英冠球队谢菲尔德联，闯入了十六强。通过下面的前瞻了解我们与“渔夫”之战的所有必备信息！
创造历史
弗利特伍德镇在2009年还在英格兰第六级别联赛，仅用八个赛季就升至英乙联赛第四名。
在英乙度过九个赛季后，他们在2023年降入英乙，并一直效力至今。
尽管在2010年代飞速崛起，但弗利特伍德在英联杯的历史上并没有掀起太大波澜，直到本赛季。
两场对阵同级别球队切斯特菲尔德和什鲁斯伯里的胜利，让他们迎来了与英冠球队谢菲尔德联的主场对决。瑞斯·诺灵顿-戴维斯的乌龙球帮助球队取胜，历史上首次闯入十六强。
他们在今季英乙联赛中尚未完全进入状态，过去八场比赛仅赢下三场、其中一场。但马特·洛勒的球队将把这一点抛在一边，全力争取晋级俱乐部历史上的首个四分之一决赛。
主教练言论
阿尔特塔：“我们的声誉、我们的自尊，一切都在其中。所以每次你踢一场比赛，尤其是对阵不同级别的球队时，要尊重比赛，尊重每一个对手，因为他们配得上这种尊重，然后努力去赢球，踢得比他们更好。”
“我们知道其中的风险，在足球中，当你能够匹配某些方面时，事情可能会变得非常势均力敌，这就是为什么我们的基本功和习惯必须达到极高水平才能赢得比赛。”
洛勒：“冠军来到镇上，来到了我们的主场。球员们需要为之兴奋，而不是感到畏惧。我们给予极高的尊重，但不能心存恐惧。”
“我们赢得了这样一场比赛。我们经历了一轮又一轮艰难的比赛，没有一场是容易的。走到今天这一步，我们实至名归。”
球队新闻
皮埃罗·因卡皮耶和克里斯蒂安·莫斯克拉在主场战胜埃弗顿的比赛中进入替补席，因卡皮耶在缺席对阵拜仁的比赛后再次进入比赛大名单。莫斯克拉自1-0战胜阿斯顿维拉因伤下场后尚未出场，但已经连续三场进入比赛大名单。
米克尔·阿尔特塔在对阵太妃糖的比赛前排除布卡约·萨卡，因其正接受进一步评估。他加入了威廉·萨利巴和赫里斯托斯·齐奥利斯的伤病名单，后者二人正努力重返一线队。
至于我们的主队，中场安迪·卡农已恢复训练并可供选择，尽管主帅马特·洛勒表示会控制他的出场时间。
后卫芬利·波特尽管眼角有伤口，但也具备出场条件。中场凯恩·汤普森-萨默斯和后卫威尔·约翰逊因伤将缺席本场比赛。
战术探讨
阿德里安·克拉克：“在马特·洛勒的带领下，弗利特伍德镇喜欢采用3-1-4-2阵型，因此看看他们是否有勇气在我们面前使用双前锋将非常引人入胜。如果他们选择更为实用主义的踢法，这种阵型可以轻松转变为5-4-1，而不会造成重大混乱。”
“洛勒在这次杯赛前还有另一个战术难题，那就是他希望在多大程度上敦促球员对我们进行逼抢。在英乙联赛中，他们是最好的‘逼抢球队’，产生了最多的逼抢序列，以及第二高的前场高位抢断次数。如果他们踢出自己的自然风格，可能会为自己赢得进球机会，但如果我们能通过传球撕裂防线，他们的后防线可能会变得非常暴露。”
“弗利特伍德镇是一支定位球强队，在这种情况下已经打进了六个联赛进球。总体而言，这支来自菲尔德海岸的球队在将传中球送入危险区时表现最好。他们在公开战传中数量方面排名联赛第二。随着射手罗南·科夫兰和切德·埃文斯争顶这些皮球，他们确实在定位球中构成了威胁。”
“在个人方面，请关注充满侵略性的右边翼卫刘易斯·麦肯。这位苏格兰人是一位积极的球权争夺者，喜欢向前推进并将传中球兜进禁区。”
“弗利特伍德最具创造力的球员是中场马克·赫尔姆。他已经创造了23次机会，其中22次来自运动战，比队内任何其他球员多出10次。”
事实与数据
我们此前在任何赛事中都未曾与弗利特伍德交手。在历史上对阵顶级联赛对手的五场比赛中，鳕鱼军团一场未胜（1平4负）。
弗利特伍德将成为我们在联赛杯中面对的第68支不同的球队。在过去18次对阵这类俱乐部中，我们仅输掉了一场（13胜4平），那是2006年1月0-1不敌维甘竞技。
这是我们第10次在联赛杯中对阵来自英格兰第四级别的球队。此前九次对决中有八次晋级，但在最近一场比赛中，于2012/13赛季因1-1战平后在点球大战中被布拉德福德淘汰。
弗利特伍德镇历史上首次闯入联赛杯第四轮。在本赛季之前，他们在20场比赛中仅晋级6次，并且在20场比赛中仅完成了一场零封——但鳕鱼军团本赛季至今尚未失球。上一支在单赛季联赛杯中完成四场零封的第四级别球队是1988/89赛季的特兰米尔流浪者。
埃贝雷奇·埃泽在最近四场对阵非英超球队的联赛杯出场中参与了七个进球（两粒进球，五次助攻），在上赛季我们2-0战胜维尔港的比赛中他曾取得进球。
马克斯·多曼在对阵伊普斯维奇的第三轮比赛中打入两球，当时他年仅16岁258天。他在联赛杯中已经出场三次——在英超俱乐部中，未满17岁前出场次数比他更多的球员只有哈维·埃利奥特，他在满17岁之前曾为富勒姆（1次）和利物浦（3次）出场过四次。
比赛官员
迈克尔·萨利斯伯里将吹罚我们对阵弗利特伍德镇的比赛。他此前曾两次执法我们的比赛——2023年9月4-0战胜伯恩茅斯以及2025年4月2-2战平水晶宫。
我们造访海布里球场时将没有VAR。这是因为EFL的规定：VAR只能在赛事中每个拥有比赛场地的球场都能使用该技术的轮次中使用。
如果90分钟战平，比赛将直接进入点球大战。如果我们晋级，抽签仪式将于周三晚间在天空体育主赛事频道现场直播。
裁判：迈克尔·萨利斯伯里，助理裁判：马修·威尔克斯和亚历克斯·詹姆斯，第四官员：刘易斯·史密斯
现场直播
天空体育主赛事频道是您观看我们客场对阵弗利特伍德镇比赛的地方，比赛将于英国时间晚上8点开球。
您还可以在世界任何地方查找转播此次比赛的电视台。

items.titleEn: U21s preview: AFC Wimbledon v Arsenal
items.summaryEn: We face the League One side looking to progress to the knockout stages of the EFL Trophy
bodyEn: Our under-21s take on AFC Wimbledon on Tuesday evening (6pm UK) looking to progress to the knockout stages of the EFL Trophy for the first time.
After defeat to Barnet in our opening game in the group stages, we battled to a deserved 2-1 win over Leyton Orient, meaning we enter the final round of fixtures second in Southern Group F.

Three points in tonight's contest would see us make it through to the last 32, while a win on penalties would leave us waiting for Leyton Orient's result against Barnet on Tuesday, November 10 to discover our fate.
EARLY FORM FADES FOR DONS
After a promising start to the season, Wimbledon have hit something of a rut in October.
The Dons are without a win since a 1-0 success against Doncaster Rovers on September 12, going seven games without a victory in all competitions since.

Both matches in the EFL Trophy have ended in defeat for the south London side, although they do have two points on the board. Wimbledon took both Barnet and Leyton Orient to penalties, but were beaten on spot kicks by both opponents.
Wimbledon's only hope of progressing to the knockout stages is to beat us at the Cherry Red Records Stadium and hope that Leyton Orient don't beat Barnet by a bigger margin.

bodyEn: The headlines around Fleetwood Town are rarely about what happens on the pitch. Noteworthy elements include Jamie Vardy’s celebrated status as a former player, a partnership signed with a team in Uzbekistan and the owner Andrew Pilley resigning in 2023 after being convicted of fraud, for which he was jailed for 13 years. There is often something noteworthy going on in relation to the Fylde coast club.

It is no different this week, although this time football is taking centre stage as Arsenal head to Highbury Stadium on Tuesday for a Carabao Cup fourth-round tie against the League Two side. There is no link to the Gunners’ former home in Islington and the ground is a world away from what the visitors are used to, its capacity a fraction of the Emirates Stadium. The Championship side Sheffield United were deservedly beaten there in the previous round, unable to cope with their opponents or the conditions, but the Cod Army anticipate a sterner test from Mikel Arteta’s aristocrats.

Even against the Blades, the ground was less than half full but Tuesday will bring the venue’s biggest football attendance; the only other time it has sold out was for a fireworks display. The capacity is 5,300 and the stadium has four parking spaces, leaving Arsenal representatives to find alternatives on the street.

Fleetwood have a loyal local fanbase and occasions such as this can aid growth. Since the draw they have sold about an extra 200 season tickets to supporters keen to guarantee a place at the best show in town.

“It’s definitely the biggest game we’ve hosted, the Premier League champions at Highbury,” the club legend and assistant coach Nathan Pond says. “I think it’s just going to be a special night for everyone involved at the club.”

Pilley was the driving and financial force behind the club’s rise from non-league to a decade in League One, from which they were relegated in 2024. He handed the reins to his son Jamie, and some feel Pilley Sr’s absence has left a hole.

Away from high-profile managers including Uwe Rösler, Graham Alexander, Charlie Adam, Scott Brown and Joey Barton, a long-term project was growing in the background. Rösler and Barton were close to leading Fleetwood into the Championship, losing play-off semi-finals in 2016-17 and 2019-20 respectively. Defeat at Exeter last Saturday left the club 18th in League Two.

Matt Lawlor, the head coach since January, is an under‑the‑radar figure considering the names of some of his predecessors. He is a local who spent his playing career in non-league, representing Bamber Bridge for much of it. Lawlor has progressed from hard‑as-nails midfielder to impressive coach, spending time working for Manchester United’s foundation before joining Fleetwood’s respected academy. Regarded as a firefighter, he took charge for caretaker/interim spells at Fleetwood and their Irish sister club, Waterford, in between being part of the staff under Adam and Pete Wild, whom he succeeded.

At academy level, the club is aiding the careers of players and coaches. Bournemouth’s James Hill came through the ranks and the sale of Josh Feeney to Aston Villa in 2021 funded improvements that allowed the youth set-up to gain category two status. Three staff members have moved to Premier League clubs in recent months.

Fleetwood tried to establish global links beyond Waterford. In 2015, they announced their short‑lived partnership with Lokomotiv Tashkent, as part of which players were invited from Uzbekistan to Fleetwood for trial. They founded Fleetwood United in Dubai in 2021 but sold the club in 2024.
In South Africa they created Western Cape Fleetwood Football Club in 2021 and partnered with Hout Bay United Football Community a year later but are no longer involved with either project.

Fleetwood’s training ground, opened by Sir Alex Ferguson in 2016, is regarded as one of the best facilities in the EFL. The club make money from hosting touring youth teams there, as part of which matches against local academy and grassroots teams – including Fleetwood’s – are offered.

The training ground is open to the public, meaning fans can sit at the cafe and take in a session before chatting with the players about all and sundry, but mainly football. “The fans do come down quite a lot and interact with staff and players, which I think is important for a community football club like ourselves,” Pond says.

“There’s no barriers between us. I think that’s really important for the club we’ve come from, to maintain those things. Some of the loyal fans who come down to the training ground every now and then and go to every game, they’ve got an understanding and they’ve had conversations with the players. After a bad result, there’s no malice in it because they know the character of the lads.”

Being on a peninsula could make conditions interesting for Arsenal, with wind and rain predicted in the wake of Storm Boelo. “You can play the first half [against] the wind, come out for the second half and still be against it,” Pond says. “It goes in all directions.”
Pond made 498 appearances for Fleetwood across seven divisions between 2003 and 2018 before returning to be part of the coaching staff. His teammates in the Conference Premier included Vardy.

“I meet people on the street, people who know I used to play for Fleetwood,” Pond says. “The first question they ask is: ‘Did you play with Vardy?’ Even on the Vardy documentaries, Fleetwood gets a mention. He’s put us in the limelight.”
They are back there, for one night at least.

items.titleZh: “风向四面八方”：弗利特伍德准备在海布里球场湿冷迎接阿森纳
items.summaryZh: 阿森纳将在联赛杯第四轮客场对阵英乙球队弗利特伍德，后者正迎来队史最大规模的主场比赛之一。
bodyZh: 围绕弗利特伍德镇的头条新闻很少与球场上的表现有关。值得注意的元素包括杰米·瓦尔迪作为前球员的知名身份、与乌兹别克斯坦一支球队签署的合作关系，以及老板安德鲁·皮利在2023年因欺诈罪被判入狱13年后辞职。关于这家位于菲尔德海岸的俱乐部，总有一些值得关注的事情发生。
本周也没有什么不同，尽管这一次足球成为了焦点，阿森纳将于周二前往海布里球场参加对阵这支英乙球队的联赛杯第四轮比赛。这与枪手此前在伊斯灵顿的旧主场没有任何关系，该球场与客队习惯的球场相去甚远，其容量只是酋长球场的一小部分。英冠球队谢菲尔德联队在上一轮比赛中在那里被当之无愧地击败，无法应对对手或场地条件，但“鳕鱼军团”预计米克尔·阿尔特塔的精英球队将带来更严峻的考验。
即使在对阵刀锋军团时，球场上座率也没有达到一半，但周二将带来该场地最大的足球上座率；它唯一一次门票售罄是举办烟花汇演。容量为5,300人，球场只有四个停车位，这让阿森纳代表不得不寻找街头替代方案。
弗利特伍德拥有忠实的本地球迷基础，这样的机会可以促进增长。自抽签以来，他们已经向热衷于保证在镇上最好演出中获得一席之地的支持者额外售出了大约200张季票。
“这绝对是我们主办过最大的一场比赛，英超冠军来到海布里，”俱乐部传奇人物兼助理教练内森·庞德说。“我认为对于俱乐部涉及的每个人来说，这将是一个特殊的夜晚。”
皮利是该俱乐部从非联赛崛起并在英甲度过十年的推动力和资金力量，他们于2024年降级。他将大权交给了他的儿子杰米，一些人认为老皮利的缺席留下了一个真空。
除了包括乌韦·罗斯勒、格雷厄姆·亚历山大、查理·亚当、斯科特·布朗和乔伊·巴顿在内的备受瞩目的主教练之外，一个长期项目正在幕后成长。罗斯勒和巴顿险些率领弗利特伍德升入英冠，分别在2016-17赛季和2019-20赛季的附加赛半决赛中失利。上周六客场负于埃克塞特后，该俱乐部在英乙联赛中排名第18位。
考虑到他的一些前任的名字，自1月以来担任主教练的马特·劳勒是一个低调的人物。他是一名当地人，职业生涯在非联赛度过，大部分时间代表班伯布里奇。劳勒从一名硬朗的中场球员成长为一名出色的教练，在加入弗利特伍德备受尊崇的青训营之前，曾在曼联基金会工作过。被视为一名救火队员，他曾在弗利特伍德及其爱尔兰姐妹俱乐部沃特福德担任看守/临时主帅，之后成为亚当和皮特·王尔德手下的工作人员，并接替了后者。
在青训层面，该俱乐部正在协助球员和教练的职业生涯。伯恩茅斯的詹姆斯·希尔是通过青训营培养出来的，2021年将乔什·费尼出售给阿斯顿维拉获得的资金资助了基础设施的改善，使青训体系获得了二级资格。最近几个月，三名员工已转投英超俱乐部。
弗利特伍德试图建立超越沃特福德的全球联系。2015年，他们宣布了与塔什干火车头的短命合作关系，作为其中的一部分，邀请了乌兹别克斯坦的球员前往弗利特伍德试训。他们于2021年在迪拜创立了弗利特伍德联队，但在2024年将其出售。
在南非，他们在2021年创建了西开普弗利特伍德足球俱乐部，并在一年后与豪特湾联足球社区合作，但不再参与这两个项目。
弗利特伍德的训练基地由阿历克斯·弗格森爵士于2016年启用，被认为是EFL最好的设施之一。该俱乐部通过在那里接待巡回青年队来赚钱，作为其中的一部分，他们提供与当地青训营和草根球队（包括弗利特伍德的球队）的比赛。

训练基地对公众开放，这意味着球迷可以坐在咖啡馆里观看训练，然后与球员聊聊各种事情，主要是足球。“球迷们确实经常来这里与员工和球员互动，我认为这对于像我们这样的小区足球俱乐部来说很重要，”庞德说。
“我们之间没有障碍。我认为这对于我们出身的俱乐部来说非常重要，能够保持这些东西。一些偶尔来到训练基地并观看每一场比赛的忠实球迷，他们有一种理解，并且与球员进行了对话。在糟糕的结果之后，里面没有恶意，因为他们了解小伙子们的性格。”
身处半岛可能会让阿森纳的比赛条件变得有趣，在博埃洛风暴之后，预计会有风雨。“你可以顶风踢上半场，下半场出来后依然是顶风，”庞德说。“风向是四面八方的。”
在2003年至2018年间，庞德在七个级别联赛中为弗利特伍德出场498次，之后回归成为教练组的一员。他在议会全国联赛中的队友包括瓦尔迪。
“我在街上遇到人，知道我曾为弗利特伍德效力的人，”庞德说。“他们问的第一个问题是：‘你和瓦尔迪一起踢过球吗？’即使在瓦尔迪的纪录片中，弗利特伍德也被提及。他让我们成为了聚光灯下的焦点。”
他们又回到了那里，至少度过一个夜晚。

items.titleEn: Finding Confidence Through Football: Adam and James’ Journey
items.summaryEn: Read how the Talking Tactics programme has helped Adam and James...
bodyEn: To celebrate National Mentoring Day, we are spotlighting Adam and James, participants in the Talking Tactics programme at Arsenal in the Community who have taken positive steps to improve their mental health, build confidence, and work towards their goals, with the support of their mentor, Gemma.

When Adam joined the programme, he was struggling with his mental health and confidence. He often struggled to leave the house or talk to other people. As an avid Arsenal fan, he found something to look forward to in attending sessions at the Arsenal Hub, which helped him settle into the programme.

"Because of my mental health and my lack of confidence. There were multiple days where I was struggling to even get out of bed and was scared of the outside world, so I just kept myself inside and wasn’t talking to people. At the start of the programme I also wasn’t attending school," Adam explained.
For Adam, the football environment made all the difference to how comfortable he felt accessing support.
"CAMHS felt more like a hospital environment, but the Hub had fun and football going on, and fun colours rather than dull colours, which played a part in how I viewed it."

Through regular sessions with Gemma, Adam built a trusted relationship and worked towards goals that mattered to him. These included improving his confidence, understanding his emotions, becoming more social and thinking about his future.

Sessions focused on emotional literacy and regulation, developing tools to support his wellbeing, and building confidence. As Adam progressed, his sessions moved from the Arsenal Hub to school, helping him work towards returning to education.
His love of football helped him build a relationship with a trusted adult, while the programme's adapted approach supported him to feel comfortable and engaged.
By the end of the programme, Adam was attending school on a full timetable and had even begun venturing out by himself.
Reflecting on what he enjoyed most, Adam said: "One thing I enjoyed most was achieving my goals because I felt more relief and it made me more confident because I know I can do it."

Like Adam, James joined Talking Tactics looking for support that met him where he was. Accessible, inviting and rooted in a familiar environment. Following a recent ADHD diagnosis, he wanted help managing distractions, maintaining focus at school and dealing with frustration and challenging situations.

As an avid Arsenal fan, James was able to access support in an environment that felt familiar and welcoming. His sessions took place at the Arsenal Hub each week, where a range of activities helped him explore his goals and develop strategies to manage everyday challenges.
"Our sessions took place at the Arsenal Hub. It was very nice and calm, we sometimes played football. I liked coming and doing them outside the Arsenal stadium," James shared.

Sessions included board and card games, interactive activities and occasional football-based exercises to help James understand goal-setting in different ways. These activities provided opportunities to learn and reflect while building a positive relationship with his mentor.
James also developed strong relationships with the wider Arsenal Hub community staff, helping the Hub become somewhere he enjoyed visiting each week.
What made that huge difference was that relationship with Gemma. Someone James could relate to, and someone who was invested in his wellbeing.
"I got on very well with my mentor, because she’s kind and we had fun in sessions."

Having a trusted adult who listened and supported him helped James engage with the programme and think about his future. One of his long-term goals is to improve his grades at school, giving him something positive to work towards beyond his time on Talking Tactics.

James’ love of Arsenal was an important part of his Talking Tactics journey. By recognising this passion and incorporating it into his support, the programme helped connect him with opportunities that felt meaningful to him, including attending Arsenal’s match against Leeds United on World Mental Health Day.

Adam and James' experiences highlight the importance of supporting young people where they are. By combining trusted mentoring relationships with the familiar surroundings, Talking Tactics creates opportunities for young people to feel comfortable, build confidence and work towards meaningful goals.
For more information on the mentoring programme, please email Advantage Mentoring Coordinator Gemma Benham gbenham@arsenal.co.uk

items.titleZh: 通过足球寻找自信：亚当和詹姆斯的旅程
items.summaryZh: 了解“谈论战术”项目如何帮助亚当和詹姆斯建立自信并改善心理健康。
bodyZh: 为庆祝全国导师日，我们聚焦于阿森纳社区基金会“谈论战术”项目的参与者亚当和詹姆斯，他们在导师杰玛的支持下，在改善心理健康、建立自信和实现目标方面迈出了积极的步伐。
当亚当加入该项目时，他正与心理健康和自信心不足的问题作斗争。他经常很难离开家或与其他人交流。作为一名狂热的阿森纳球迷，他在参加阿森纳训练中心的课程中找到了期待，这帮助他融入了该项目。
“由于我的心理健康和缺乏自信，有很多天我甚至很难起床，并且对外界感到害怕，所以我只是把自己关在家里，不和别人说话。在项目开始时我也没有去上学，”亚当解释道。
对亚当来说，足球环境彻底改变了他对获得支持的舒适感。
“CAMHS（儿童及青少年心理健康服务）感觉更像是一个医院环境，但训练中心有有趣的活动和足球，还有鲜艳的色彩而不是沉闷的色彩，这对我如何看待它起到了作用。”
通过与杰玛的定期交流，亚当建立了一种值得信赖的关系，并朝着对他重要的目标努力。这些目标包括提高自信、理解自己的情绪、变得更有社交能力以及思考自己的未来。
课程重点关注情绪素养和调节、开发支持其福祉的工具以及建立自信。随着亚当的进步，他的课程从阿森纳训练中心转移到了学校，帮助他朝着重返校园迈进。
他对足球的热爱帮助他与一位值得信赖的成年人建立了关系，而该项目适应性的方法则支持他感到舒适和投入。
到项目结束时，亚当已经按全日制课程表上学，甚至开始独自外出。
在回顾他最喜欢的部分时，亚当说：“我最喜欢的一点是实现我的目标，因为我感到了更多的放松，这让我更有自信，因为我知道我能做到。”
像亚当一样，詹姆斯加入“谈论战术”是为了寻求切合实际的支持。这种支持是无障碍的、诱人的且扎根于熟悉的环境中。在最近被诊断出患有注意力缺陷多动障碍（ADHD）后，他希望获得帮助来应对干扰、在学校保持专注以及处理挫折和具有挑战性的情况。
作为一名狂热的阿森纳球迷，詹姆斯能够在熟悉且受欢迎的环境中获得支持。他的课程每周在阿森纳训练中心举行，各种活动帮助他探索目标并制定应对日常挑战的策略。
“我们的课程在阿森纳训练中心举行。那里非常美好和平静，我们有时会踢足球。我喜欢来这里并在阿森纳球场外做这些，”詹姆斯分享道。
课程包括棋盘和纸牌游戏、互动活动以及偶尔的足球练习，以帮助詹姆斯以不同的方式理解设定目标。这些活动提供了学习和反思的机会，同时与他的导师建立了积极的关系。
詹姆斯还与阿森纳训练中心的更广泛工作人员建立了牢固的关系，这使训练中心成为他每周都喜欢光顾的地方。
带来巨大改变的是与杰玛的关系。一个詹姆斯能产生共鸣的人，一个关心他福祉的人。
“我和我的导师相处得很好，因为她很善良，我们在课程中玩得很开心。”
有一个倾听并支持他的值得信赖的成年人，这帮助詹姆斯参与到项目中并思考他的未来。他的长期目标之一是提高学校的成绩，这为他在“谈论战术”项目之外的时期提供了值得努力的积极目标。
詹姆斯对阿森纳的热爱是他“谈论战术”旅程的重要部分。通过认可这份热情并将其融入支持中，该项目帮助他接触到了对有意义的机会，包括在世界精神卫生日现场观看阿森纳对阵利兹联的比赛。
亚当和詹姆斯的经历突显了在青年人所在的地方支持他们的重要性。“谈论战术”通过将值得信赖的导师关系与熟悉的环境结合起来，创造了让年轻人感到舒适、建立自信并朝着有意义的目标迈进的机会。
有关导师计划的更多信息，请发送电子邮件至优势导师协调员杰玛·本哈姆 gbenham@arsenal.co.uk

items.titleEn: Our 2026 Ballon d’Or results in full
items.summaryEn: Find out how all our nominees got on at the 70th edition of the Ballon d'Or in London
bodyEn: London hosted the 70th edition of the Ballon d'Or awards, and plenty of Gunners lined the red carpet in the capital.
Eight players were up for awards across the men's and women's teams at the London Palladium ceremony.
Away from the football, Bukayo Saka received the Socrates Award for his incredible humanitarian work.

Our number seven picked up the award after working with multiple charities, including long-term projects with Big Shoe, providing medical care and humanitarian aid for children and families in need in London and around the world.
Meanwhile, Mariona Caldentey and Alessia Russo were our two nominees for the Ballon d’Or Féminin after helping us win the FIFA Women's Champions Cup earlier this year.
Having finished second and third in 2025, our Spanish midfielder placed 13th, with Alessia finishing ninth. Alexis Putellas won the top honour for the third time in her career.
In the Men’s Ballon d’Or, Declan Rice, Gabriel and William Saliba were our three representatives after a stellar season.
Saliba placed 29th, Gabriel ranked 21st, with Rice the highest of our Gunners in 15th.
David Raya was nominated for the Yashin Trophy for best goalkeeper. The award was won by fellow Spaniard, Unai Simon.

We were nominated for Men’s Club of the Year for the third time in our history after lifting the Premier League for the first time since 2004, as well as reaching the UEFA Champions League final. PSG were given the honour.
Mikel Arteta was nominated for Men’s Coach of the Year, which was won by Spain head coach Luis de la Fuente.

与此同时，卡尔登特伊和鲁索作为我们的两名女足金球奖提名人出席，此前她们帮助我们在今年早些时候赢得了国际足联女足冠军杯。
在2025年分别获得第二和第三名之后，我们的西班牙中场排名第13位，阿莱西亚则排名第9位。普特ellas第三次赢得这一最高荣誉。

萨利巴排名第29位，加布里埃尔排名第21位，赖斯则是我们阿森纳球员中排名最高的，位列第15位。

米克尔·阿尔特塔被提名男子年度最佳教练，该奖项由西班牙国家队主教练路易斯·德拉富恩特获得。

items.titleEn: Arteta on Fleetwood, Gyokeres and basics
items.summaryEn: Mikel Arteta previews our trip to Highbury to face Fleetwood Town in the Carabao Cup fourth round
bodyEn: Mikel Arteta said our basics and habits "must be through the roof" if we are to progress in the Carabao Cup as we head to Fleetwood Town.
After defeating Ipswich in round three, we face a trip to Highbury Stadium for our first-ever meeting with the League Two side.

It's our first visit to a fourth division side in the competition since losing to Bradford City in 2012, where Mikel was an unused substitute, and the boss knows everything is on the line as we head to Highbury.

He said: "Our reputation, our pride, everything is in play. So every time you play a football match, and especially against a team in a different division, respect the game, respect every opponent because they deserve to do that, and then try to win and try to play a bit better than them.

"We all have one [upset] at some stage. We know the risk, and in football, things can get very equal the moment you are able to match certain things, and that's why our basics and habits have to be through the roof to be able to win the game."
Viktor Gyokeres started our 2-0 win over Everton, his first Premier League start after starting in the third round against Ipswich.
While Viktor is yet to get off the mark this season, Mikel is seeing positive signs from the Swedish striker.

"He's done a lot of good things," Mikel said shortly after our win over the Toffees. "We need to keep insisting. I think he had a really good contribution in Munich as well when he came on, he helped us to change the game, and that's what we need from all of them."
Max Dowman was voted player of the round thanks to his two-goal contribution against the Tractor Boys at Portman Road, and will be looking to do the same again in round four.

Another player hoping to add to his appearance tally this campaign is Cristhian Mosquera. The defender came off with an injury during our win at Villa Park in August but has since recovered to feature in the last three matchday squads.

Speaking on his contribution, Mikel said: "When he has played, he's done really well. We have won some big games playing with him, and we need him. The same with Myles [Lewis-Skelly] in another way and looking at the way he's playing.
"Or Max, today he came in [against Everton] and he seems to be very comfortable. In this kind of position. We're going to need everybody. I'm convinced of that."

items.titleZh: 阿尔特塔谈对阵弗利特伍德、哲凯赖什及比赛基础
items.summaryZh: 阿尔特塔展望联赛杯对阵弗利特伍德的比赛，并谈到了球队的基础与哲凯赖什的表现。
bodyZh: 米克尔·阿尔特塔表示，如果我们想在联赛杯中晋级，客场对阵弗利特伍德镇时，我们的基本功和习惯“必须达到极高的水平”。
在第三轮击败伊普斯维奇后，我们将前往海布里球场，迎来队史首次与这支英乙球队交手。
这是自2012年输给布拉德福德城以来，我们首次在该项赛事中做客对阵第四级别球队（当时米克尔作为替补未出场），主帅深知此行不容有失。
他说：“我们的声誉、我们的骄傲，一切都在其中。因此，每当你踢一场足球比赛，尤其是对阵不同级别的球队时，都要尊重比赛、尊重每一个对手，因为他们配得上这种尊重，然后努力去赢球，踢得比他们更好。”
“我们都在某个阶段经历过爆冷。我们知道风险所在，在足球世界里，一旦对手能够在某些方面与你抗衡，局势就会变得非常均势，这就是为什么我们的基本功和比赛习惯必须达到极高水平才能赢得比赛。”
维克托·哲凯赖什在2-0击败埃弗顿的比赛中首发登场，这也是他在继第三轮对阵伊普斯维奇之后，迎来的首场英超首发。
尽管维克托本赛季尚未破门，但米克尔从这位瑞典前锋身上看到了积极的迹象。
米克尔在战胜太妃糖后不久表示：“他做了很多出色的事情。我们需要继续坚持。我认为他在慕尼黑替补登场时也有非常出色的贡献，他帮助我们扭转了局势，这正是我们对所有球员的期望。”
马克斯·道曼凭借在波特曼路对阵拖拉机男孩时的两粒进球当选本轮最佳球员，他期待在第四轮中再次复制这一表现。
另一位希望在本赛季增加出场次数的球员是克里斯蒂安·莫斯克拉。这位后卫在8月份客场对阵维拉的比赛中因伤离场，但此后已经康复并进入了最近三场比赛的大名单。
在谈到他的贡献时，米克尔说：“当他出场时，他表现得非常出色。有他出场时我们赢下了一些重要比赛，我们需要他。迈尔斯[刘易斯-斯凯利]也是如此，他在另一个方面表现出了自己的比赛方式。”
“还有马克斯，今天他（对阵埃弗顿）替补登场，在这个位置上显得非常自如。我们需要每一个人。对此我深信不疑。”

items.titleEn: Bukayo Saka wins Sócrates Award
items.summaryEn: Bukayo Saka has won the Socrates award in the Ballon d"Or ceremony for his humanitarian work
bodyEn: Bukayo Saka has won the Socrates Award at the Ballon d'Or ceremony for his tireless humanitarian work.
The award, named after the legendary Brazilian footballer, was first given out in 2022 to Sadio Mane, and is presented for the best humanitarian work done by a footballer worldwide.

Bukayo and his family have worked with multiple charities, including long-term projects with Big Shoe, providing medical care and humanitarian aid for children and families in need in London and around the world.

The work has funded emergency housing and shelters for families displaced by the devastating earthquakes in Turkey and Morocco. work has also helped more than 100 children in Nigeria and all over Africa with transformative surgeries that would have otherwise been out of reach.
Everyone at the club would like to congratulate Bukayo on his incredible achievement.

俱乐部上下恭喜布卡约取得这一不可思议的成就。
